incidents.name: TcrToken/Tecra pool unauthorised USDT drain
incidents.notes: TcrToken exposed a mint/exchange path that let the attacker obtain TCR without paying for it and redeem it against the project's USDT pool 0x420725a69e79eeffb000f98ccd78a52369b6c5d4, emptying the pool in one transaction.

sources.ref: onchain review: TcrToken 0xE38B72d6595FD3885d1D2F770aa23E94757F91a1 created 2021-04-13T12:34:15Z by 0xd0d82531f85d9ee7ee5bb6c96e01445a0b911d4d, unrelated to the attack sender; no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment (296.9 days). Loss read from the tx receipt: 639,222.25 USDT moved from the pool to the attacker EOA (USD-pegged at 1:1), materially larger than the ~$65K sometimes quoted for this incident.
